summary: Validated new Tutor IA maximize + per-message actions feature end-to-end. Backend export inlines all 5 required markers; frontend Playwright harness covers 25 UI assertions (FAB -> open -> maximize -> backdrop -> restore -> thumbs up/down toggle & mutual exclusivity -> copy -> close -> regression testids). All passed.
critical_code_review_comments: tutor.js: feedbackStore is in-memory only - no backend submit endpoint wired up. Acceptable for now (testids let future tooling capture it) but should be flagged for next iteration if Didaxis wants persisted feedback.
tutor.js togglePanel auto-exits maximized state on close (good UX). Confirmed.
tutor.css uses backdrop-filter: blur(8px) with -webkit prefix - Safari iOS <13 fallback is missing but acceptable elsewhere.
tutor.js copyMessage uses navigator.clipboard with textarea+execCommand fallback - robust for SCORM iframes where clipboard API is often blocked.
Per-message action toolbar emits unique data-testid='tutor-msg-actions-<n>' counter - good for selector targeting.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_tutor_maximize_export.py (new pytest validating exported HTML inlines the 5 new tutor markers)
seed_data_creation: Used existing project from GET /api/projects (first item). Wrote a tutor_test/ harness in /app/frontend/public so Playwright can load the production tutor assets - bypassing the Content-Disposition: attachment header on /api/exports/<file>.html which forces a download in the browser.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Exported HTML at /api/exports/<file>.html is served with Content-Disposition: attachment, so Playwright cannot navigate to it directly (browser triggers a download). For UI testing of exported-only widgets (tutor, vlibras, etc.) use the standalone harness at /tutor_test/index.html on the public frontend, which sources the same /app/backend/services/export_assets/*.{js,css} files. Backend inlining was verified independently by grepping the downloaded HTML for the 5 required markers (.tutor-backdrop, .tutor-panel.maximized, toggleMaximize, data-testid=tutor-maximize-button, data-testid=tutor-msg-copy).
